review.reviewer: Claude, maintainer-authorized source and dependency review (AF-CTR-03 delegated author, part A1b); PR review is recorded separately
review.rationale: AF-CTR-03 part A1b: the account's writes on the center (step-up with single-use evidence, passkey registration of a signed-in account, profile, credential and device changes, sign-out, session and device revocation with its cascade, command receipts for those writes and the incident command admin revoke-sessions), the A1a review's routed items (state.resource on every not_found and already_exists, the attestation format read before go-webauthn parses it, a warning log for an unanswered auxiliary commit), and the Container's start environment following the deployed Worker version (a center left running under another version's start settings is restarted before a request is forwarded; its health states the surfaces it serves). The Worker sources change (worker/foundation/cloud-container.ts, worker/ingress/routes.ts and the generated center tables). No module, package, base image, toolchain, legal file or migration changes; go-webauthn's webauthncbor package is part of the admitted go-webauthn module. It supersedes the A1b admission at cloud-release-r68 with the third review fix round of Cloud #120: a duplicate registration whose second receipt lookup fails answers that lookup's retryable failure instead of a final code_reused, the refusal check pins the arcError clause with its one named exemption, and the docs and comments state the receipt, retry and busy-attempt rules exactly; the center sources and their tests changed after r68.
